LAWN GAMES

Dropster (Plinko)

From $125 CAD

Add a touch of excitement to your event with our Dropster game!

Similar to the classic Plinko, this interactive game features customizable panels, making it perfect for corporate branding, stag and doe fundraisers, or any event where fun meets strategy.

Guests drop tokens from the top and watch them bounce through pegs to land in prize slots below.

Create unforgettable moments with this eye-catching game that’s as entertaining to watch as it is to play.

A guaranteed crowd-pleaser for any occasion!
